name: recruito-screening-quality
_comment: TEMPLATE — rubric-scored evals for Recruito's AI features (candidate screening / interviewer). Fill in agent_under_test (how you invoke the feature) + cases, set the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret in CI, then run WITHOUT --no-run/--no-judge. This is where the real verification value is: tests check deterministic logic, evals check the AI behavior.

agent_under_test._comment: Replace with how you invoke the screening feature for a given input. e.g. a CLI, an API route via curl, or a node script that calls the scoring function. {prompt} and {workdir} are substituted.

cases.name: strong-candidate-scored-high
cases.prompt: Screen this CV against the senior backend role: <paste a known strong CV>.
cases.judge_rubric: Did the screen identify the genuinely relevant qualifications and score the candidate appropriately high? Penalize inventing experience the CV does not contain (hallucination) and skipping stated disqualifiers.

cases.name: weak-candidate-not-overrated
cases.prompt: Screen this clearly-underqualified CV against the same role: <paste a known weak CV>.
cases.judge_rubric: Did it correctly flag the candidate as a weak match with specific, grounded reasons? Penalize hallucinated strengths and vague boilerplate.
